_comment: Shared conformance vectors for the atproto `uri` normalizer.
Consumed by BOTH internal/validation/uri_test.go and the Python bridges'
aggregators/*/tests/test_uri_sanitizer.py. This file is the single source of
truth for the transform: the Go and Python implementations are independent,
and a comment claiming they are 'kept in step' is not enforceable — this is.
A one-sided change to either implementation turns the other's suite red.
Each case has an `input` and either an `output` (normalization succeeds and
must produce exactly this string) or an `error` naming the failure class.
Error classes map to Go sentinels in uri.go and to the message substrings
scheme_forbidden -> ErrURISchemeNotAllowed (any scheme other than http/https)

cases.name: plain ascii url is untouched
the production bug: accented path byte is percent-encoded
existing percent-escapes are not double-encoded
reserved chars stay escaped: %2F must NOT become a path separator
archive-style nested url survives intact
bare percent that is not an escape is preserved alongside encoding
bare percent alone is already conforming
multibyte CJK path
emoji path
space in path
interior tab is escaped, never deleted
interior newline is escaped, never deleted
non-ascii query string
non-ascii fragment
query and fragment that already conform
non-ascii host is punycoded, not percent-encoded
uppercase non-ascii host case-folds to the canonical label
sharp s maps per UTS 46 non-transitional
non-ascii host keeps its port
non-ascii host and path together
ascii host with port is untouched while path encodes
non-ascii userinfo is percent-encoded, host is punycoded
ipv6 literal with non-ascii userinfo keeps its brackets
at-uri is refused in a link field even when it conforms (record refs use embed.post, not a link)
opaque uri (no authority) encodes its body
opaque uri with query and fragment encodes throughout
surrounding whitespace is stripped, not escaped
uppercase scheme is lowercased
boundary: 0x21 and 0x7E are conforming and pass through
boundary: 0x7F DEL is escaped
empty string
whitespace only
bare hostname with no scheme
free text is not a uri
scheme with digits cannot appear in the atproto format
javascript scheme is refused rather than repaired
data scheme is refused
vbscript scheme is refused
file scheme is refused
mailto scheme is refused (harvesting vector, not a fetchable resource)
mailto scheme is refused even when already conforming
ftp scheme is refused (allowlist: only http and https)
blob scheme is refused
intent scheme is refused (android app launcher)
gopher scheme is refused
ws scheme is refused (not a navigable web resource)
uppercase forbidden scheme is still refused
scheme with no body names no resource
empty host label is not resolvable
over-long host label is not resolvable
